_readme: PROJECT DATA - edit this file (or use the Data Editor at /#/editor) to change what the website shows. Every value comes from SPR-Brochure-11-05-2026.pdf; 'source' fields give the brochure page. Use null for anything that is not provided - the website then hides it instead of inventing it.

project.name: Shan Poornam Residence
project.tagline: Boutique Living in the Heart of Madurai
project.introLine: A New Perspective on Living in Madurai

project.statement: Live life to the fullest in a thoughtfully planned, centrally located, ultra-modern residence.
project.developer: Shan Poornam Development Pvt. Ltd., an ENS Development company
project.credit: A signature project by Shan Poornam Development Pvt. Ltd., an ENS Development company in collaboration with SKR Elite Properties Pvt. Ltd.
project.threeBhkFrom: Our 3BHK starts from 1472 sqft carpet area.

philosophy.meaning: Meaning Five (in Sanskrit), representing the five elements - Earth, Fire, Water, Air and Space. This is symbolized by the Sun in the Shan Poornam logo.
Meaning Completeness (in Sanskrit) - symbolized by The Moon, the symbol of calm, rhythm, and reflection.

project.philosophySummary: At Shan Poornam Residence, the philosophy of the Sun-Moon balance inspires homes that combine energy and purpose. The result is a residence that feels complete and built to last.
advantages: Maximum Usable Living Space (85% Carpet Area / Super Built-Up Area - highest among builders in Tamil Nadu)
Thoughtfully Designed for Everyday Comfort and Long-Term Value

areaDefinitions.carpet: Carpet Area is the space inside your home.
areaDefinitions.superBuiltUp: Super Built-Up (SBU) Area is your carpet area + shared common areas.

floors.label: Terrace
floors.summary: Planned as a wellness and leisure zone, offering residents spaces to recharge and connect.

floors.label: 5th Floor
floors.summary: 2 residences: 1 x 4 BHK and 1 x 3 BHK. The 5th-floor plan is not published in the brochure.
floors.derivation: The brochure lists 26 homes (4 BHK x 1, 3 BHK x 13, 2 BHK x 12) and states that Types A-F are available on the 1st-4th floors only (24 homes). The remaining 1 x 4 BHK and 1 x 3 BHK are therefore on the 5th floor.
